node.label: Indonesia wildfires & haze
node.summary: Peatland fires and transboundary haze in Southeast Asia.

facts.text: CREA estimated pollution deaths rose to **5,310** in September. Singapore invoked its **Transboundary Haze Pollution Act**.
facts.plain: CREA estimated pollution deaths rose to 5,310 in September. Singapore invoked its Transboundary Haze Pollution Act.

facts.text: Indonesia's wildfires burned **1.9 million hectares** (Jan-Sep 2026), mostly peatland, worsened by **El Nino** and the **Indian Ocean Dipole**.
